        ol.order_id,

        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        ol.qty AS total_qty,
        s.sku_code AS root_sku
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE st.store_name = 'Amazon-JP-13'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023

        be.sku_code,
        be.is_bundle,
        uc.qty * be.total_qty AS total_qty,
        be.root_sku

    JOIN u_composition uc

WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, get all completed orders from Amazon-US-00 in 2024
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-US-00'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKU and quantity
order_sku_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        sk.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode compositions
-- We track: the original order line, current item being exploded, its kind, code, and accumulated quantity
exploded AS (
    -- Base case: start from order lines with SKUs
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.line_no,
        osl.line_qty,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        'sku' AS current_kind,
        osl.sku_code AS current_code,
        osl.line_qty AS accumulated_qty
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand current item through valid composition edges
    SELECT 
        e.order_id,
        e.line_no,
        e.line_qty,
        e.order_date,
        e.root_sku_code,
        uc.child_kind AS current_kind,
        uc.child_code AS current_code,
        e.accumulated_qty * uc.qty AS accumulated_qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = e.current_kind 
       AND uc.parent_code = e.current_code
       AND uc.valid_from <= e.order_date
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Get all paths that end at components (not assemblies)
component_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        e.*,
        c.component_id,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.component_code
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN component c 
        ON e.current_kind = 'component' 
       AND e.current_code = c.component_code
),

-- Filter to only parts (non-assembly components) and the specific part we want
target_part_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.order_id,
        cp.line_no,
        cp.line_qty,
        cp.order_date,
        cp.root_sku_code,
        cp.accumulated_qty AS part_qty_per_unit,
        cp.line_qty * cp.accumulated_qty AS total_part_qty
    FROM component_paths cp
    WHERE cp.is_assembly = false
      AND cp.component_code = 'LEG-407-OAK-00192'
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_part_qty), 0) AS total_units_consumed
FROM target_part_consumption
